# AgentDNA

> AgentDNA is the security layer for AI agents. It verifies every agent's identity and delegated authority, enforces context-aware access throughout agentic workflows, and keeps tamper-evident proof of every protected interaction.

AgentDNA checks every hand-off in an agent's work, not just the login at the start: user → agent → tool → app → output. It is built on three pillars: Evolved Identity (GRADE), Contextual Access (CBAC) and Irrefutable Auditing (the Provenance Layer). Engineers add it to an agent with the AgentDNA Python SDK; security teams work in the AgentDNA Dashboard.
